reader.requirement: At --std 85, in both SEARCH formats, after imperative-statement-1 (AT END) or imperative-statement-2 (WHEN) runs without ending in a GO TO, control passes to the end of the SEARCH statement (no further WHEN is evaluated and the search does not continue); one that ends with GO TO transfers to its target.
reader.edition-search: grep of ControlFlowEmitter (EmitSearch, EmitSearchScan, EmitSerialScan, EmitAllScan, EmitSearchWhens) and SearchBinder for Edition/Year/DialectBehavior/ConstructRegistry: the only edition read on the SEARCH path is DialectBehavior.SearchIndexBelowTableUnsuccessful in BindSearch, which sets the format-1 start bound and not the transfer after an imperative statement; the goto __searchEnd after each arm is edition-blind
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf15_05/06 cover the WHEN and AT END arms; a second true WHEN after the first, GO TO-terminated arms in both formats and a SEARCH inside an in-line PERFORM were not exercised

probes.printed: A-W1 2 / A-AFTER Y=1 / B-END / B-AFTER Y=2 / C-HIT / C-AFTER / D-END / D-AFTER / E-HIT / P-E / F-END / P-F / G-1 / G-TAIL 1 / G-2 / G-TAIL 2 / P-G (MATCH)
probes.expected: after an arm, control to the end of the SEARCH (second WHEN not taken, statement after END-SEARCH runs); a GO TO-terminated arm transfers to its target in both formats; within an in-line PERFORM each SEARCH end resumes the loop and a GO TO leaves it

reader.notes: EmitSearchWhens emits goto __searchEnd after each WHEN body unless it terminated (EmitStatementList returns true for a transfer), and EmitSearchScan does the same after the AT END body; GO TO sets __pc and jumps to the dispatcher transfer label so no loop captures it.

refuter.evidence: Attack: an arm whose last statement is a transfer verb that may not transfer. §1985:VI.6.15.4 GR3 (GO TO DEPENDING with identifier out of range passes to the next statement) and §1985:X.5.4.4 GR1 (EXIT PROGRAM in a program not under a calling program continues with the next executable statement). Probe r5a MATCH: GO TO P-Z DEPENDING ON D (D=7) ending the WHEN arm and the AT END arm of format 1 and of format 2, and EXIT PROGRAM ending a WHEN arm and an AT END arm, in a main program: each reaches the end of the SEARCH ('A-W1 / A-AFTER / B-END / B-AFTER / C-HIT / C-AFTER / D-END / D-AFTER / E-W1 / E-AFTER / F-END / F-AFTER'), the second true WHEN is not entered and P-Z is never reached. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.22.4 GR5 ... the text is in GR5'; 'OK  §1985:VI.6.15.4 GR3 ... the text is in GR3'; 'OK  §1985:X.5.4.4 GR1 ... the text is in GR1'.
